item.title: Gambit 0.1.4
item.description:
# Gambit 0.1.4
Released September 18, 2026.
## New Tab and audio fixes
- Fixed New Tab Page searches that fell through to `about:blank`; standalone submissions now navigate through the trusted native host. - Removed the dead gap between the last horizontal tab and the New Tab button. - Added real Chromium audio detection so the per-tab audio control appears only while a Chromium tab is playing, not on every tab.
This release supersedes Gambit 0.1.3 in the Sparkle update feed.
